profile_anchor.reason: The first algebra-preserving Q4_K instruction rewrite produced only 1.023x graph speedup; the Q8 hotspot is the next independent large share.

method.instrumentation: bounded per-shape counters at the tinyBLAS Q8_0 x Q8_0 dispatch, emitted once at process shutdown
required_fields: m, n, k, lda, ldb, ldc
wall and cycle share with instrumentation disabled

selection_rule: Select only a shape family accounting for at least 70% of Q8 tinyBLAS calls or cycles and having an Amdahl whole-request ceiling above 1.10x.
correctness_boundary: The profile build is not a candidate runtime. No speed, output, quality, or novelty claim may use instrumented timings.
stop_rules: Do not optimize an assumed Q8 shape before the counted receipt is terminal.
Do not promote an activation approximation without exact target control plus CUTE and MATH gates.
Do not stack further sub-three-percent Q4_K instruction substitutions on the current node.
